title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)

Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht. Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Identifikation von KI-Use-Cases in Kundenprojekten – und die ehrliche Einschätzung, wann ein Agent die richtige Antwort ist und wann eine deterministische Lösung die bessere Agentic Coding im eigenen Arbeitsalltag: KI-Werkzeuge produktiv und verantwortungsvoll in Entwicklung, Review und Delivery einsetzen – und dem Team zeigen, wie es geht Technologische Beratung unserer Kunden bei Architektur-, Technologie- und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen Sicherstellung von Code-Qualität durch Clean Code, Tests, Reviews und Best Practices Aktive Mitgestaltung unseres wachsenden KI-Kompetenzfelds – Themen setzen, Wissen ins Team tragen, Standards etablieren Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der modernen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Fullstack-Umfeld – du bist und bleibst Entwickler <3 Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und generativer KI in echten Projekten: Prompting, RAG, Embeddings/Vektor-Datenbanken, Function Calling, Fine-Tuning oder Agenten-Frameworks. This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business. Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future. YOUR MISSION Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured. Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation. Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 10,000 people and serve over 120 million customers in 26 languages. We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of growth opportunities, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling and gaming. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, featuring more than 1.38 million In-Play sporting events a year. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe (750,000), we handle over 6 billion HTTP requests daily and process more than 1.5 million bets per hour at peak. Job Description As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining and evolving our Sports Trading and Tools Applications and Platform We’re building our first technology teams based in Denver Colorado and are looking for talented technical experts to join our Trading & Tools Software Development team. The Trading and Tools teams build and own software that ingests and broadcasts the broadest, most accurate, real-time sports fixture and trading related data to our customers internally and externally. The teams technology stack is evolving and we want you to help us on the journey of delivering the next generation trading platform and products. You will initially work on a Microsoft stack using .NET and SQL Server, developing and delivering changes to our current desktop applications and backend services. To enable you to deliver our next gen trading platform you’ll be cross skilled into Golang, React and Google Cloud Platform technologies. The day-to-day work is interesting and challenging amidst a hardworking and delivery focused Company ethos. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to tackle some of technology’s greatest challenges. An interest and understanding of American Football, Basketball, Ice Hockey and/or Baseball would be beneficial. This role is eligible for inclusion in the Company’s hybrid working from home policy. Salary range for this position is $120,000-$155,000 Qualifications 5+ Years commercial C# experience. Solid understanding of Windows applications and services. Commercial MS SQL Server experience. Self-driven with ability to understand complex architecture Proven track record of delivering high quality, scalable, software solutions. Self-motivation and delivery orientated in a fast paced environment. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Coaching/mentoring experience on technical subject areas. Flair for problem solving. Additional Information Developing low latency, highly available and scalable solutions that process high volumes of data. Supporting and enhancing the existing code base. Performing root cause analysis to create solutions to stop fault reoccurrence. Enhancing and supporting existing trading functions, some of which are used 24/7. Supporting product owners as required. Providing support to the testing team during testing phases of projects. Providing technical guidance and mentorship to support team members professional development. Identifying technical areas of improvement. Contributing to solution proposals as required.
